title: Dense fibre opens contain component generic points
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism and $U\subseteq T$ open such that the restriction is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. For every $t\in U$ and every dense open subset W of its fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre], every irreducible-component [def-weil-irreducible-components] generic point [def-sc-generic-point] belongs to W.

source.place: Tag 054U, first sentence; locally noetherian component argument

proof.text: For t in U, the fibre is isomorphic to a fibre of the restricted locally finitely presented morphism. It is locally of finite type over the residue field and hence locally noetherian. Fix a component generic point z and choose a noetherian affine open neighbourhood A of z. The intersection of its component with A is an irreducible component of A and has generic point z. There are finitely many components of A. Remove all the other components; the resulting open O contains z and is contained in its component, and is nonempty. The dense open W intersects O in a point y. Since y belongs to the closure of z, z generalizes y; openness of W forces z to lie in W. This proves the inclusion for every component generic point. Empty fibres have no component generic points.

proof_origin.place: Tags 054T and 054U; expanded restriction and topology steps
